places.name: Old Quebec (Vieux-Québec)
places.ai_summary: Old Quebec is a UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring cobblestone streets, historic buildings, and charming cafes.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and restaurants have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Take a guided walking tour to learn about the history.
places.address: Old Quebec, Quebec City, Quebec, Canada

places.name: Fairmont Le Château Frontenac
places.ai_summary: Fairmont Le Château Frontenac is a historic luxury hotel and one of the most photographed landmarks in Quebec City.

opening_hours.notes: Hotel tours require prior booking.

places.place_tip: Visit the Dufferin Terrace for stunning views of the St. Lawrence River.
places.address: 1 Rue des Carrières, Quebec City, Quebec, Canada

places.name: Mont-Tremblant
places.ai_summary: Mont-Tremblant is a popular resort town known for skiing, hiking, and its picturesque pedestrian village.

opening_hours.notes: Ski resort hours vary by season.

places.place_tip: Take the gondola ride for panoramic views.
places.address: Mont-Tremblant, Quebec, Canada

places.name: Old Montreal (Vieux-Montréal)
places.ai_summary: Old Montreal is known for its well-preserved historic buildings and vibrant cultural scene.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and restaurants have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the cobblestone streets and visit the Notre-Dame Basilica.
places.address: Old Montreal, Montreal, Quebec, Canada

places.name: Notre-Dame Basilica of Montreal
places.ai_summary: A masterpiece of Gothic Revival architecture, the Notre-Dame Basilica is famous for its stunning interior and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on certain holidays; check the official website.

places.place_tip: Attend a mass or concert for a unique experience.
places.address: 110 Notre-Dame St W, Montreal, Quebec, Canada

places.name: Montreal Biodome
places.ai_summary: The Montreal Biodome is a unique attraction where visitors can experience four different ecosystems of the Americas.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the penguin exhibit and the tropical rainforest.
places.address: 4777 Pierre-de-Coubertin Ave, Montreal, Quebec, Canada

places.name: Plains of Abraham
places.ai_summary: The Plains of Abraham is a historic area and park in Quebec City, site of the famous battle in 1759.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor center hours vary; check locally.

places.place_tip: Visit the Museum of the Plains of Abraham for historical exhibits.
places.address: 390 Rue de Bernières, Quebec City, Quebec, Canada

attribution.title: ClarendonHotel
attribution.author: Colin Rose from Montreal, Canada
attribution.description: The Clarendon Hotel, or Clarendon House (French: Hôtel Clarendon), is a high-end hotel in the historic part of Quebec City. It is the oldest continuously operating hotel in the city.

places.name: Montmorency Falls Park
places.ai_summary: Montmorency Falls Park is home to the stunning Montmorency Falls, which are higher than Niagara Falls.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Take the cable car for a breathtaking view of the falls.
places.address: 5300 Boulevard Sainte-Anne, Quebec City, Quebec, Canada

places.name: Mount Royal Park
places.ai_summary: Mount Royal Park is a large park in Montreal, offering stunning views of the city and a beautiful lake.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor center hours vary; check locally.

places.place_tip: Hike to the summit for a panoramic view of Montreal.
places.address: 1260 Remembrance Rd, Montreal, Quebec, Canada

places.name: Montreal Museum of Fine Arts
places.ai_summary: The Montreal Museum of Fine Arts is one of the most prominent art museums in Canada, featuring a vast collection of art from around the world.

opening_hours.notes: Free admission on Wednesdays from 5 pm to 9 pm.

places.place_tip: Check out the temporary exhibitions for contemporary art.
places.address: 1380 Rue Sherbrooke O, Montreal, Quebec, Canada

places.ai_summary: Île d'Orléans is a picturesque island near Quebec City, known for its agricultural products and stunning landscapes.

opening_hours.notes: Check local listings for seasonal farm hours.

places.place_tip: Try the local strawberries and visit the charming villages.
places.address: Île d'Orléans, Quebec, Canada

places.name: Gaspé Peninsula (Gaspésie)
places.ai_summary: The Gaspé Peninsula is known for its dramatic coastlines, national parks, and the famous Percé Rock.

opening_hours.notes: National park hours vary; check locally.

places.place_tip: Visit the Forillon National Park and take a boat tour to see the coastline.
places.advanced_booking: Essential for accommodations in peak season
places.address: Gaspé Peninsula, Quebec, Canada

places.name: La Citadelle de Québec
places.ai_summary: La Citadelle de Québec is a historic fortress with museums and stunning views of the St. Lawrence River.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the history and architecture.
places.address: 1 Côte de la Citadelle, Quebec City, Quebec, Canada

opening_hours.notes: Visitor center hours vary; check locally.

places.place_tip: Try the river rafting and hiking trails.
places.address: Jacques-Cartier National Park, Quebec, Canada

places.ai_summary: The Olympic Park in Montreal is a sports complex with a unique architectural design, home to the famous Olympic Stadium.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary depending on events; check the official website.

places.place_tip: Visit the Montreal Biodome and Botanical Garden nearby.
places.address: 4141 Pierre-De Coubertin Ave, Montreal, Quebec, Canada

places.ai_summary: Jean-Talon Market is one of the largest public markets in North America, offering a wide variety of fresh produce and local products.

opening_hours.notes: Open year-round, but hours may vary on holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit in the morning for the freshest produce and fewer crowds.
places.address: 7070 Avenue Henri-Julien, Montreal, Quebec, Canada

places.name: Canadian Museum of History (Gatineau)
places.ai_summary: The Canadian Museum of History is located across the river from Ottawa in Gatineau, Quebec. It is the most visited museum in Canada, featuring exhibits on Canadian history and culture.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays from September to June.

places.place_tip: Visit the IMAX theatre for a unique movie experience.
places.address: 100 Rue Laurier, Gatineau, Quebec, Canada

places.ai_summary: A stunning national park in Quebec, featuring the deep and majestic Saguenay Fjord.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor center hours vary; check locally.

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour to fully experience the fjord.
